title: Privacy
metaTitle: Privacy Policy - Sell Your Gas Royalties
metaDescription: How we collect, use, and protect the information you share when requesting a gas royalty offer or contacting us - plainly explained.
heroLead: This explains what we collect when you reach out about a mineral interest, why we collect it, and how it's handled.
intro: When you request an offer, ask a question, or send us documents about a mineral or royalty interest, you're sharing information that ranges from a name and phone number to, later in a real transaction, sensitive things like a Social Security number or tax ID. This page explains how we handle all of it, in plain language rather than dense legal boilerplate, because a privacy policy nobody can actually read isn't much of a policy.
If anything here is unclear, contact us directly and ask - we'd rather explain it than have you guess.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: Contact information you provide directly - name, phone number, email, and mailing address - when you request an offer or reach out through the contact page. Documents you choose to send us, such as royalty statements, deeds, division orders, or leases, when you're requesting a valuation. Basic technical information collected automatically when you visit the site, such as browser type and pages viewed, used to understand how the site is used and to keep it functioning properly.

If a sale moves forward, we collect additional information needed to close - identifying information for the deed and closing paperwork, and tax identification information required for reporting. This is only collected when it's actually needed for that stage of the transaction, not upfront.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use the information you provide to evaluate your mineral or royalty interest, communicate with you about your inquiry or offer, and, if you choose to sell, to complete title work and closing. We do not use documents you send us for any purpose beyond evaluating and, if applicable, completing a transaction with you.
We may use aggregated, non-identifying information about site usage to improve the resources and pages on this site, but that's separate from the personal information tied to your specific inquiry.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Information may be shared with parties directly necessary to complete a transaction you've chosen to pursue - a title company, closing agent, or attorney involved in the sale, for example - and with service providers who help us operate the site or process communications, under confidentiality obligations. We may disclose information if required by law, such as in response to a valid subpoena or court order.

If you request an offer but don't proceed to a sale, your information is retained only as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your inquiry and for our own recordkeeping, not indefinitely for unrelated marketing purposes.

sections.heading: How we protect it
paragraphs: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards to protect information you share with us, particularly sensitive documents and identifying information involved in a closing. No method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security, but we take the sensitivity of financial and title documents seriously and handle them accordingly.

We recommend not sending sensitive information like a full Social Security number over unsecured channels until you're at the closing stage of an actual transaction with us, and we'll tell you clearly when that stage has been reached.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us at any time what information we have on file related to your inquiry, request that we delete information if you're not pursuing a transaction, or opt out of any non-essential communications. Contact us directly to make any of these requests, and we'll respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Updates to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy periodically to reflect changes in how we operate or in applicable law. Material changes will be reflected on this page, and continued use of the site or continued communication with us after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy. If you have an open inquiry or transaction with us when a change occurs, we'll handle your information consistent with the terms in effect when you originally provided it, unless you're told otherwise.

faqs.question: Do you sell your contact information to other buyers?
faqs.answer: No. We don't sell your personal information to third parties. Information is only shared with parties directly necessary to complete a transaction you choose to pursue, such as a title company or closing agent.

faqs.question: What happens to your documents if you do not end up selling?
faqs.answer: Your documents are retained only as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your inquiry and for our own recordkeeping. You can request deletion at any time by contacting us directly.

faqs.question: Is it safe to email your royalty statements?
faqs.answer: Statements alone generally don't contain highly sensitive personal information, but if you have concerns, contact us first and we can discuss a secure way to share documents, especially anything containing a Social Security number or account information.

faqs.question: Can you see what information you have about you?
faqs.answer: Yes - contact us directly and we'll tell you what information related to your inquiry we have on file and can walk through any deletion or correction requests.
